name: Hall Leys Park Play Area
description: Riverside park in Matlock town centre, run by Derbyshire Dales District Council, with a children's play area, a paddling pool (April to the end of September), a boating lake, toilets and a café with indoor and outdoor seating. Some facilities close in winter.

nearby.label: Paddling pool, April to end of September
Town centre car parks; nearest is Olde Englishe, off Dale Road
